items.exampleEn: Federal workers will get a small pay rise next year.
items.exampleZh: 聯邦政府的員工明年會小幅加薪。

items.exampleEn: The new phone's advertising campaign uses songs written by students.
items.exampleZh: 這款新手機的廣告宣傳活動採用學生寫的歌。

items.exampleEn: After a short trial, the shop decided to sell the new bread every day.
items.exampleZh: 試賣一段時間後，那家店決定每天都賣這款新麵包。

items.exampleEn: The judges chose three candidates for the final round of the cooking contest.
items.exampleZh: 評審選出三位候選人進入烹飪比賽的決賽。

items.exampleEn: A troop of monkeys ran across the road in front of our car.
items.exampleZh: 一群猴子從我們的車前跑過馬路。

items.exampleEn: The Soviet Union existed from 1922 to 1991.
items.exampleZh: 蘇聯從一九二二年存在到一九九一年。

items.exampleEn: More than half of the voters in the company chose the new logo.
items.exampleZh: 公司裡超過一半的投票者選了新標誌。

items.exampleEn: Football fans from both cities sang together, united by their love of the game.
items.exampleZh: 兩座城市的足球迷一起唱歌，因為對這項運動的熱愛而團結在一起。

items.sentenceEn: In the history museum, we saw old Soviet coins and stamps.
items.sentenceZh: 在歷史博物館裡，我們看到舊的蘇聯硬幣和郵票。

items.audioEn: The library's reading campaign starts next week, and every child who reads ten books gets a prize.
items.audioZh: 圖書館的閱讀活動下週開始，每個讀完十本書的孩子都能得到獎品。
items.questionZh: 孩子怎麼樣才能得到獎品？

items.sentenceEn: In the board game, you move your troops across a map of old castles.
items.sentenceZh: 在那款桌遊裡，你要在一張古堡地圖上移動你的部隊。

items.sentenceEn: The neighbors were united in their wish to save the old park.
items.sentenceZh: 鄰居們一致希望保住那座老公園。

items.stemEn: Each ____ for class leader gave a short speech before the vote.
items.stemZh: 每位班長候選人在投票前都發表了簡短的演說。

items.stemEn: Many young ____ in our school are voting for the first time.
items.stemZh: 我們學校有許多年輕的投票者是第一次投票。

items.passageEn: This term, our school's student club held an election for its new leader. Three candidates ran, and each one planned a small campaign with posters and short videos. One candidate, Kim, promised a free one-week trial for any new club activity, while another wanted to reduce the club's carbon footprint. Before the vote, the club teacher showed us a short film about how elections work in different countries, including the federal system in the United States. On voting day, every voter dropped a card into a box. Kim won, and the club became more united than ever. Even the losing candidates helped plan the first event.
items.passageZh: 這學期，我們學校的學生社團選舉新社長。有三位候選人參選，每個人都用海報和短片規劃了小型的競選活動。其中一位候選人 Kim 承諾，任何新的社團活動都可以免費試參加一週；另一位則想減少社團的碳足跡。投票前，社團老師給我們看了一部短片，介紹不同國家的選舉怎麼進行，包括美國的聯邦制度。投票當天，每位投票者都把卡片投進箱子裡。Kim 當選了，社團變得比以前更團結。連落選的候選人也一起幫忙規劃第一場活動。

options: 每個月請大家吃一次披薩
延長每天社團活動的時間

questions.questionZh: 選舉之後社團變得怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 這個軟體有三十天的免費試用期。
referenceEn: This software has a thirty-day free trial.
There is a free trial of thirty days for this software.
rubricZh: trial 在這裡指試用（例如 a free trial）

items.promptZh: 這個宣傳活動是為了鼓勵大家少用塑膠。
referenceEn: The aim of this campaign is to get people to use less plastic.
This campaign encourages people to use less plastic.
rubricZh: campaign 指宣傳活動（例如 this campaign 等）
「鼓勵大家」可寫，例如 encourage people to…、get people to… 等
「少用」可寫，例如 use less、cut down on 等
